# Send start throttling, completion logging and forced activity flushes have different contracts

The original generator delays send starts by 60 ms per extension; fixed accepted source delays both send and save starts by 125 ms. The caller records activity only after its primary send promise resolves and before its explicit additional FCC copy. A separate 10-second idle task finalizes the log. The original timing test uses sequential sends and a total elapsed threshold, while activity tests force the flush observer. Those assertions do not directly prove every start interval, overlapping-call serialization or idle-timer expiration. Static code and historical test reports remain separate.

Scope: WebExtension MessagesSendTracker and its callers/tests.
